meta.home: Software engineer based in Budapest. I build real-time platforms, full-stack applications, and tools that people actually use.

footer.quote: "Code is read far more often than it is written."

projects.title: Things I've built

list.name: PeerPrep
list.description: A real-time study platform where students form groups, chat live, and get AI help writing their event posts. Built with FastAPI and React.

list.name: Polaris LMS
list.description: A learning management system where teachers post assignments, students submit work, and everyone gets their own dashboard. Built on Laravel.

list.name: Erasmus+ Mobility Portal
list.description: The live course selection portal for incoming Erasmus+ students at the University of Split. Deployed and actively used by real exchange students every semester.

list.name: Transport Tycoon
list.description: A JavaFX desktop game where you build road and rail networks, dispatch buses and trains, and try to run a profitable transport company.

list.name: Stargate Game
list.description: A browser multiplayer game where players move around a shared grid and race to collect the most debris. No frameworks, just plain JavaScript.

list.name: Booklovers Hub
list.description: A social platform for readers: follow friends, share books, write reviews, and build your personal collection. Built with Laravel.

list.name: Comment Remover
list.description: A published VS Code extension that strips comments from source files across seven languages. Thousands of downloads on the Marketplace.

list.name: MoodLens
list.description: An AR app that reads facial expressions and tone of voice in real time, then uses AI to reflect back how you're feeling.

list.name: CLF-02 Flashcards
list.description: An Anki-style flashcard app for prepping the AWS CLF-02 exam. Flip through cards, track what you know, drill the gaps.

list.name: Knights Game
list.description: A two-player Java Swing game where knights move in chess patterns, paint tiles as they go, and race to connect four in a line.
